meta.description: Estimates species trees under the multispecies coalescent from per-locus gene trees with the modern ASTER astral binary (ASTRAL-III/wASTRAL/ASTRAL-Pro), plus SVDQuartets, BPP, and StarBEAST2.
meta.executed: 9/9 inputs executed (ASTER Windows build astral/wastral/astral-pro, Java ASTRAL 5.7.8, IQ-TREE 2.4.0, DendroPy, SciPy); PAUP*/SVDQuartets, BPP, StarBEAST2 not executed (no Skill command)
meta.execution_note: Re-audit of the fixed Skill: 7 pre-fix inputs re-run as regression tests plus 2 new inputs (N = 9). Per-locus IQ-TREE gene trees were reused from the pre-fix audit (runs/inN/loci.treefile; command unchanged except the binary name); every ASTER, concordance-factor and asymmetry step and the shipped example (which re-infers its own gene trees) were re-run. SYNTHETIC data (data/make_data.py).

scientific_integrity.detail: All numbers come from runs on synthetic multispecies-coalescent data with known species trees.

methodological_ground.detail: localPP never read as bootstrap; introgression claimed only with a significant minority-quartet asymmetry; units reported as CULength or SULength explicitly.

code_usability.detail: Every ASTER and IQ-TREE command in SKILL.md ran (exit 0), including the split concordance calls and astral-pro -a; examples/astral_pipeline.sh now completes (exit 0 after 306 s) and writes cf_g/cf_s outputs.

functional_suitability.note: Concordance calls, ASTER units, astral-pro -a, contraction scope and the asymmetry test are fixed and verified. Completeness 3: SVDQuartets, BPP and StarBEAST2 still have no command, control file or XML. Correctness 3: the frontmatter description still says ASTRAL branch lengths are coalescent units, contradicting the fixed body.

reliability.note: Accurate Common Errors table; no check that leaf names are consistent across gene trees, so a renamed sample silently becomes an extra species (Input 9).

agent_usability.note: Flag mapping and units now accurate in the body; description and the 'Approach' line (contract <10% before ASTRAL) lag behind the fixed guidance.

human_usability.note: Natural prompts in usage guide; description is a 900-character jargon block.

security.note: Local tools only; no taxon-label validation.

maintainability.note: Shipped example now runs end to end with a binary resolver; no test data or expected output shipped.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger and routing; StarBEAST2 routing no longer circular; seeds in example.

recommendations.title: Add a leaf-name consistency check before ASTRAL
recommendations.problem: A sample renamed in 30 gene trees became an extra species with exit 0 and no warning.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill has no input validation step for gene-tree label sets.
recommendations.fix: Tell the agent to compare leaf sets across gene trees, check '#Species' in the ASTER log, and use astral -a with a map file (as for astral-pro) when names differ.

recommendations.root_cause: The fix edited the body but not the description.
recommendations.fix: State units depend on binary and flag; say contraction applies to standard bootstrap and wASTRAL is the default guard.
